newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY LEAGUE-NEW ZEALAND XIII BEAT BRITAIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY LEAGUE-NEW ZEALAND XIII BEAT BRITAIN.

text.p: A New Zealand XIII ran in six tries to beat Britain 30-22 in a rugby league tour match on Tuesday.
The New Zealand side opened the scoring with a try in the eighth minute by winger Iva Ropati.
Hitro Okesene linked up with Denvour Johnston to score another try for the home team in the first half and Whetu Taewa made it three.
But Britain had two tries of their own from Joey Hayes and Barrie-Jon Mather and trailed just 14-10 at the interval.

Centre Anthony Swann and stand-off Shane Endacott added further tries for the New Zealand side but Britain responded with scores from scrum-half Tony Smith and Karl Hammond, leaving the Lions just two points down with eight minutes left.
But Endacott clinched victory for the home team with a 74th-minute try which was converted by full-back David Murray to end the Lions' unbeaten tour record.
St Helens forward Chris Joynt, returning for Britain after a knee injury, played the full match.
Britain face New Zealand in Auckland on Friday in the first of three tests.
